entries.title: A waiting task says where its wait ends
entries.body: A task waiting on other work now names the last task in that line and what it waits for: a time, or an app update. When a task waits for an Infinitary update, it carries on once that update is installed on its computer, instead of at the time it was given.

picture.alt: Two task board tiles: one waiting on another task that waits for an app update, and one whose wait runs through that task to the one waiting for the update
